risks.title: Risk of mining exploration without guarantee of profitability
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk mentioned in the summary and extensively discussed. Direct language: « no guarantees that subsequent development... will occur » and « may not realize profits ». Central to strategy (Tanbreez and Wolfsberg in exploration phase). Critical weight: absence of current commercial revenues.

risks.title: Critical dependence on commercial agreements and third-party customers
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified as a long-term success factor. Conditional language: « may not occur or... may not result in appreciation ». Risk of non-realization or commercially unviable terms. Directly impacts post-production viability.

risks.title: Intense competition in the global mining industry
risks.score_rationale: Explicit sector risk mentioned in the summary and developed. Moderately intense but clear language: « domestic and global competition », « no influence or control ». Context of accelerated sector consolidation increasing competitive pressure.

risks.title: Operational and production interruption risks in mining
risks.score_rationale: Sector-specific operational risk. Warning language: « disrupted by a variety of risks and hazards » with impact « material adverse effect ». Applicable from production start. High weight for a mining company.

risks.title: Inaccuracy and volatility of mineral resource estimates
risks.score_rationale: Technical risk specific to geological estimates. Nuanced but clear language: « imprecise », « depend to some extent on interpretations ». Risk of downward resource revisions impacting future plans. Trend: revisions likely with new data.

risks.title: Internal control failures and cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: Significant deficiencies explicitly disclosed (segregation of duties, related party transactions, cybersecurity programs). Warning language: « significant deficiencies », « cannot assure you ». Risk of financial restatement and investor confidence loss. Heightened weight for a young public company.

risks.title: Compliance with anti-corruption and anti-money laundering regulations
risks.score_rationale: Explicit regulatory risk for international operations (Greenland, Austria). Direct language: « could negatively impact our reputation and results ». Applicable to high geopolitical risk mining sector. Moderate weight but critical reputation impact.

risks.title: Limited experience managing a U.S. public company
risks.score_rationale: Explicit post-SPAC governance risk. Direct language: « limited experience », « recruitment... has been delayed ». Impacts management quality and regulatory compliance. Trend: gradual improvement but high current risk.
